goal_fit.on_time: share of selected courses recommended no later than the target semester
goal_fit.accelerated: share of selected courses recommended after the current semester
goal_fit.preferred: share of preferred courses selected; omitted when preference set is empty
goal_fit.avoided: share of selected courses not in avoided set; omitted when avoided set is empty

tie_break: score descending, sorted course tuple, plan ID, plan version
recommended_policy: highest balanced score among selected plans
implementation_additions: Slot order and recommendation policy supplement the PDF and are not experimentally calibrated.
If U=L and T=L, load is zero; credit validity remains the Validator's responsibility.
Risk requires an explicitly sourced academic status; missing status is an error.
Reference credits must be supplied with a source, never inferred from GPA.
Goal criteria and weights must be explicit; an empty or zero-weight set is an error.
